text: The Patriots are heading into Week 5 with a genuine sense of momentum after pulling off a stunning Week 4 comeback to improve to 2-2, and they'll get the chance to build on that revival at home against a 3-1 Raiders team while sporting throwback uniforms that should make the Gillette faithful happy. Safety Mike Brown has been promoted from the practice squad to the 53-man roster, and linebacker Jose Ramirez has joined the practice squad, but the Patriots' backfield faces some uncertainty with Rhamondre Stevenson dealing with an injury that will need to be managed carefully heading into the AFC matchup. The defensive unit did solid work neutralizing Dalton Kincaid last week, though they're well aware that the Raiders present a formidable receiving threat in tight ends Brock Bowers and Michael Mayer—a 1-2 punch that will test New England's secondary and coverage schemes. Beyond the field, Gillette Stadium is getting upgraded with the new 15,000-square-foot JetBlue Loft as part of Kraft Sports + Entertainment's continued premium hospitality expansion, and at least one prominent analyst appears more confident in the Patriots' trajectory than the Raiders' chances moving forward.
